spanish: Todas las columnas del atrio alrededor bandeadas plata, sus ganchos plata, y sus basas bronce.
grammarChanges: Removed the unlicensed 'y' before 'sus ganchos': וָוֵיהֶם (h02027017007) is HNcmpc/Sp3mp with no HC, so the link after 'plata' is asyndetic. Kept 'y' before 'sus basas' since וְאַדְנֵיהֶם (h02027017009) carries HC.
